assignments.rationale: This is a basic geometric CONCEPT defining intersecting lines in a plane. It is distinct from the THEOREM about the condition for lines to intersect in space.

This is a THEOREM providing a specific vector condition for two lines to intersect in three-dimensional space. Its mathematical meaning (a theorem with a proof condition) differs from the simple definitional CONCEPT, so it should be split into a separate canonical node.
